description: Calculates a non-binding price estimate in EUR for a stretch ceiling (Spanndecke) from Spanndecken ROTH, Germany, with the same formula as the online calculator on spanndecken-roth.de. Only area_m2 (ceiling area in square metres) is required: the user may name just the area. Every other parameter is filled in server-side with a standard value when omitted — category A (lacquer / matt / satin), corners 4, spotlights 0, lamps 0, volume_discount false — and any value the user states overrides the standard value. The result repeats the parameters actually used and lists in defaults_applied which standard values were assumed, so tell the user about them. Surface categories: A = Lack / Matt / Satin with colour choice, B = Metallic / Exclusive / Galaxy, C = Fotodruck (photo print). Present the figure as a non-binding estimate (Richtpreis), never as an offer; the binding price follows after on-site measurement.

area_m2.description: Ceiling area in square metres (Deckenfläche in m²), e.g. 20 or 35.5. Required — the only parameter the user must provide.

category.description: Surface category (Oberflächen-Kategorie): A = Lack / Matt / Satin with colour choice, B = Metallic / Exclusive / Galaxy, C = Fotodruck (photo print). Optional; standard value A when omitted.

corners.description: Number of room corners (Raumecken); 4 are included in the price. Optional; standard value 4.

lamps.description: Number of lamps / ceiling outlets (Leuchten). Optional; standard value 0.

spotlights.description: Number of recessed spotlights (Einbaustrahler). Optional; standard value 0.

volume_discount.description: Apply the online calculator's volume-discount option (Mengenrabatt), e.g. for several rooms. Optional; standard value false.

name: calculate_spanndecken_price

defaults_applied.description: Names of the parameters the server filled in with standard values because the request did not provide them; empty when every value was given explicitly. Tell the user which values were assumed.

input.description: Parameters actually used (after validation and server-side defaults).

area_m2.description: Ceiling area used for the calculation (m²).

de.description: Estimate notice in German; show it with the result.

pricing_version.description: Version date of the pricing basis (YYYY-MM-DD).

provider.description: Identity of the provider; show the website with every result.

calculator_url.description: URL of the online price calculator.

formatted.description: Total formatted for German readers, e.g. "2.856 €".

is_estimate.description: Always true: non-binding estimate, not an offer.

total.description: Estimated total in EUR, rounded to whole euros.

title: Stretch ceiling price estimate (Spanndecken ROTH)
